desc_en: Essential silhouette for cold weather. Contemporary design with ribbed texture. Features a top pom-pom that adds subtle movement. Versatile and sophisticated chalk tone. Each piece is crafted to order with worldwide shipping available. A discreet accessory that defines the season with elegance.
